scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --target node --external electron && bun build src/preload.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external electron && bun build src/renderer.ts --outdir dist --target browser && cp src/index.html dist/index.html
scripts.smoke: bun run build && ELECTRON_SMOKE=1 electron dist/main.js
